A chorus girl (Vera-Ellen) stars in a broke producer's (Cesar Romero) show after rumors link her with a millionaire (David Niven) in Scotland.
programme.title: Happy Go Lovely

programme.desc: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.
programme.title: From Here to Eternity

programme.desc: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.
programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner

programme.desc: A San Francisco playgirl (Tippi Hedren) follows a bachelor (Rod Taylor) to Bodega Bay where, for no apparent reason, flocks of birds begin killing the populace.
programme.title: The Birds

programme.desc: A man who raises worms for food and strange experiments is faced with losing his land to real-estate speculators.
programme.title: The Worm Eaters

programme.desc: S02 E02 — The Mission Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.
programme.title: Bonanza

programme.desc: An outlaw (Dean Martin) plans to swap a cavalry colonel's (Brian Keith) wife (Honor Blackman) for a Gatling gun needed to rob a Mexican bandit.
programme.title: Something Big

programme.desc: A man who raises worms for food and strange experiments is faced with losing his land to real-estate speculators.
programme.title: The Worm Eaters

programme.desc: Paris police try to unravel the sinister secret behind a series of brutal murders.
programme.title: Theatre of Death

programme.desc: Rebel trucker "Rubber Duck" (Kris Kristofferson) blocks a crooked sheriff (Ernest Borgnine) with a CB-linked army of big rigs.
programme.title: Convoy

programme.desc: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square performs songs of hope, faith and inspiration; singing sacred hymns both new and old from around the world as well as uplifting selections from the American songbook.
programme.title: Music & the Spoken Word

programme.desc: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.
programme.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town

programme.desc: When a dirty Scotland Yard cop is linked to a string of robberies across Europe, the agency asks a famous French detective (Alan Arkin) to help them find the culprits.
programme.title: Inspector Clouseau

programme.desc: Engaged to others, two cruise-ship passengers (Cary Grant, Deborah Kerr) plan to reunite six months later atop the Empire State Building.
programme.title: An Affair to Remember

programme.desc: Wandering gunfighter Joe arrives in the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among sheriff John Baxter and the three Rojo brothers. He is hired by Esteban Rojo to join their gang, but he plays one side against the other.
programme.title: A Fistful of Dollars

programme.desc: Two vaudeville flops (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) pose as bad guys and join the Klondike gold rush with a saloon singer (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Utopia

programme.desc: Ex-American serviceman Ronnie plans a daring heist of a million pounds being transported on the Flying Scotsman express train from Glasgow, Scotland, to London.
programme.title: Mailbag Robbery

programme.desc: Doc Holliday (Kirk Douglas) joins Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and his brothers for a Tombstone showdown with the Clanton gang.
programme.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral

programme.desc: A time-warped astronaut (James Franciscus) lands on ape-ruled Earth and finds telepathic mutants worshiping an atomic bomb.
programme.title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes

programme.desc: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.
programme.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town

programme.desc: While on a business trip, an ambitious, young lawyer immediately falls in love with a stranger. They wed the following day, and tragedy soon strikes.
programme.title: Made for Each Other

programme.desc: Blondie (Penny Singleton) frets when Dagwood (Arthur Lake) buys a horse instead of a house.
programme.title: It's a Great Life

programme.desc: Irish sheep herders (Deborah Kerr, Robert Mitchum) roam with their son and helper (Peter Ustinov), making a living in the 1920s Australia.
programme.title: The Sundowners

programme.desc: Two guys (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) and a girl (Melody Anderson) brave jungle hazards to find an Aztec temple filled with gold.
programme.title: Firewalker

programme.desc: An outlaw (Dean Martin) plans to swap a cavalry colonel's (Brian Keith) wife (Honor Blackman) for a Gatling gun needed to rob a Mexican bandit.
programme.title: Something Big

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Lucy and John Wayne When Mr Mooney instructs Lucy to deliver some papers regarding the financing of John Wayne's latest movie, she ignores him and finds herself having lunch with Wayne instead.
programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.desc: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.
programme.title: Capricorn One

programme.desc: An ambulance driver and a nurse share an ill-fated romance in World War I Italy. Based on Ernest Hemingway's novel.
programme.title: A Farewell to Arms

programme.desc: John Adams (William Daniels), Benjamin Franklin (Howard da Silva) and Thomas Jefferson (Ken Howard) lead the way to the Colonies' Declaration of Independence.

Burlesque dancer Dixie Daisy is the prime suspect when rival dancers are found strangled with their own stage costumes. Aided by infatuated stand-up comic Biff Brannigan, Dixie must find the killer before she becomes his next victim.
programme.title: Lady of Burlesque

programme.desc: During the Civil War, reports of a sea monster attacking ships alarm the Navy. An investigation finds the monster is a submarine, the "Nautilus," commanded by vengeance-seeking Capt. Nemo (Allen Holubar), who was once an Indian prince.
programme.title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea

programme.desc: For his fiancée's charity a stockbroker bets friends that for 24 hours he will tell only the truth.
programme.title: Nothing but the Truth

programme.desc: An Army deserter (Ray Milland) joins a gambler (Barbara Stanwyck) and a miner (Barry Fitzgerald) against a former slave-trader building a private empire.
programme.title: California

programme.desc: The writer's (Richard Chamberlain) romance with his wife, Zelda (Blythe Danner), inspires the story of a soldier and a flirt in 1919 Alabama.
programme.title: F. Scott Fitzgerald and the Last of the Belles

programme.desc: A reporter hears how an ex-convict (James Caan) and an Indian woman (Stefanie Powers) destroyed an Old West town overnight.
programme.title: Gone With the West

programme.desc: A Harvard man (Robert Young) and his Colonial friend (Walter Brennan) join Rogers' (Spencer Tracy) Rangers in upstate New York.
programme.title: Northwest Passage

programme.desc: Two con men (Sidney Poitier, Bill Cosby) are persuaded by a retired policeman (James Earl Jones) to volunteer their services to a ghetto youth center.
programme.title: A Piece of the Action

programme.desc: The story of the heroic English nurse who was executed by a German firing squad for aiding refugees during World War I.
programme.title: Nurse Edith Cavell

programme.desc: A Broadway producer (Zero Mostel) and his accountant (Gene Wilder) back a sure-fire flop: "Springtime for Hitler."
programme.title: The Producers

programme.desc: A U.S. senator's (Victor Moore) probe of corruption leads him to Mardi Gras, a fall guy (Bob Hope) and a filibuster.
programme.title: Louisiana Purchase

programme.desc: Two guys (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) and a girl (Melody Anderson) brave jungle hazards to find an Aztec temple filled with gold.
